You judge whether an AI agent working in the RUNTIME described below can deliver what a natural-language agent skill is for. Judge the skill's core deliverable for one representative request. Optional, conditional or follow-up work (extra diagnostics, notifications, clean-up extras, publishing or production deploys the core request does not require) does not count; if the core deliverable itself is a deployment or publication, it counts. Reasoning, planning and writing text are done by the agent itself. An operation that no RUNTIME tool can really perform, or that can only succeed with an account, credential, API key, paid service or publishing right the RUNTIME does not grant, cannot be done.
Answer IMPOSSIBLE when a step the core deliverable cannot do without cannot be done in this RUNTIME; ACHIEVABLE when every such step can; UNKNOWN when you cannot tell. Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"verdict": "ACHIEVABLE" | "IMPOSSIBLE" | "UNKNOWN", "missing": ["what the runtime lacks, for IMPOSSIBLE", ...]}

RUNTIME `claude-code-cloud`: A Claude Code cloud session on Linux x86_64 (no GPU, no Docker daemon) with a shell, the working directory, sub-agents and the connectors listed as tools. Network egress goes through an allow-list proxy: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA). The user's GitHub account is usable through the github connector and through the gh CLI via the proxy. There are no accounts or credentials for other external services.
Its tools (the ONLY values allowed after 'via'):
  - `bash`: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session; network requests reach only the allow-listed hosts
  - `read`: read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)
  - `write`: create and overwrite files
  - `edit`: edit existing files and Jupyter notebooks
  - `web_fetch`: fetch a web page or unauthenticated API by URL; hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused
  - `web_search`: search the public web and read result snippets
  - `ask_user`: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation
  - `agent`: start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them
  - `skill`: load an installed Claude Code skill, list and search skills and plugins
  - `tasks`: create, read, update and stop background tasks; schedule, list and delete cron jobs and wake-ups; monitor a condition; read notifications
  - `artifact`: publish an HTML page as a private claude.ai artifact; read and answer its comments and its small data store
  - `send_user_file`: send a file from the session to the user
  - `push_notification`: send a push notification to the user
  - `mcp_resources`: list and read resources of the connected MCP servers
  - `github`: GitHub connector (the user's account): get_file_contents, create_pull_request, list_issues, issue_write, search_code, pull_request_read, actions_list, get_job_logs, create_branch, push_files
  - `notion`: Notion connector (the user's workspace): notion-search, notion-fetch, notion-create-pages, notion-update-page, notion-create-database
  - `google_drive`: Google Drive connector (the user's drive): search_files, read_file_content, create_file, update_file, share_file
  - `jam`: Jam connector (bug-report recordings): search, getDetails, getConsoleLogs, getNetworkRequests, analyzeVideo
  - `mem`: Mem connector (the user's notes): create_note, search_notes, get_note, update_note
  - `bigdata_com`: Bigdata.com connector (financial data and documents): bigdata_company_tearsheet, bigdata_search, find_securities, bigdata_fetch_document
  - `etoro`: eToro connector (the user's trading account): get-my-portfolio-summary, get-instruments-overview, prepare-trade
  - `claude_docs`: Claude Docs connector (living documents on claude.ai): create, read, batch, update, export
It does NOT provide:
  - a GPU (no NVIDIA or other accelerator; no CUDA)
  - a Docker daemon (docker, docker compose and container builds cannot run)
  - network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused, for example huggingface.co, Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA
  - accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)
  - Windows or macOS, and their GUI toolchains (Xcode, Visual Studio, PowerShell on Windows)
  - physical devices and hardware: phones, emulators, boards, cameras
  - connectors or integrations other than the tools listed
Resources it grants (usable after 'needs'): `shell`, `linux`, `local_filesystem`, `package_registries`, `allowlisted_internet`, `local_servers`, `user_conversation`, `sub_agents`, `github_account`, `notion_account`, `google_drive_account`, `jam_account`, `mem_account`, `bigdata_com_account`, `etoro_account`, `claude_docs_account`.
